# MoldStud

> MoldStud is a custom software development company specializing in AI, blockchain, and cloud solutions with a focus on WCAG accessibility compliance.

MoldStud offers comprehensive software development services across web, mobile, and enterprise platforms. The company serves multiple industries and maintains a strong emphasis on digital accessibility and inclusive design practices.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- Web Development
- Mobile Development
- AI & Machine Learning
- Blockchain
- Cloud Infrastructure
- .NET & C#
- JavaScript & Node.js
- React
- WCAG Compliance
- Digital Accessibility
- API Testing
- Graph Databases
- UX/UI Design
- IT Staff Augmentation
